title: hello (connector -> runtime)
description: First frame on a new connection. Identifies the connector, authenticates (if no Authorization header was sent), declares capabilities and optionally asks to resume a previous session.

pcp.description: Highest PCP version the connector speaks, MAJOR.MINOR. MAJOR must match the WebSocket subprotocol (pcp.v1 -> 1).

id.description: Stable connector instance id, configured in the admin console (one per platform account).

platform_version.description: Version of the platform client/API the connector drives (e.g. Camfrog client build).

host.description: Free-form host label for logs. Never an address.

self.description: The bot's own account on the platform, if known yet.

auth.description: Only when the transport could not send an Authorization header.

resume.description: Resume a previous session after a disconnect.

last_seq_sent.description: Highest seq the connector sent before the drop (informational).

buffer_from_seq.description: Lowest seq still held in the connector's replay buffer.
